installCommand: git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git flutter && flutter/bin/flutter precache --web
buildCommand: touch .env && flutter/bin/flutter pub get && flutter/bin/flutter build web --release --dart-define=SUPABASE_URL=$SUPABASE_URL --dart-define=SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
